scope: Metadata-only archive planning for declared stage=main attempt runs. Terminal status and artifact size/digest come from GitHub REST API; no artifact bodies were downloaded and no empirical values were recomputed.

archive_script_model.behavior: Each artifact is downloaded, retained, and assets >=2 GiB are split while the original still exists; the original is removed after verified parts are written.
archive_script_model.per_parent_peak_upper_formula: sum(source artifact sizes) + largest individual artifact size when that artifact is >=2 GiB
archive_script_model.caveat: Upper estimate excludes logs, provenance, checkout and runner-reserved space; it is planning metadata, not measured disk use.

single_parent_risk_policy.reason: Likely exceeds practical standard-runner free disk after accounting for an in-flight split copy; do not dispatch unchanged archival workflow for these parents, even alone.
